brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy
requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster with 3 bins: bin:0,0,0 3-compartment, bin:1,0,0 2-compartment, bin:0,1,0 full depth. Provides divided storage for small notions (buttons, bobbins, needles) and larger tools. No dedicated sewing props exist, so dressed with workshop proxies: scissors/screwdriver, tape measure, tweezers, brush representing sewing tools.

finish.summary: Built compact 3-cell organizer with divided bins for small sewing notions and larger tools. Dressed with representative workshop props (tape measure, scissors, tweezers) as no sewing-specific props exist.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
